Type-safety narrowing documented: the native useVehicleState `.state` is typed `VehicleState | string | null` (offline responses can be a bare status string); the web call site is `any`, so reading `.software_version` off a bare string yields undefined at runtime. Narrowed once (`state != null && typeof state === 'object' ? state.software_version ?? '—' : '—'`) for type safety with identical observable output. The `{state ? ... : EmptyState}` guard keeps the raw union so a bare-string state still selects the populated branch (parity with web truthiness). RN raw-text safety: `updateVersion && ...` -> `!!updateVersion && ...` and `scheduledStart && ...` -> `!!scheduledStart && ...` so an empty-string field never renders a stray text node outside <AppText> (observable output unchanged).
